description: This file defines template metaprogramming utilities for type traits, function traits, and compile-time checks within the WPEFramework project. It includes mechanisms for selecting types, inspecting function signatures, and checking for member or static member existence.

classes.name: pick
classes.description: Template struct to select the type at a given index from a parameter pack.

classes.name: func_traits
classes.description: Template struct to extract traits from various function types, including member functions, function pointers, and std::function objects.

classes.name: same_or_inherits
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types are the same or if one inherits from the other.

classes.name: sign
classes.description: Template struct to determine if a type is signed.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a member function with a specific signature exists in a type.

classes.name: IS_MEMBER_AVAILABLE_INHERITANCE_TREE
classes.description: Macro to check if a member function exists anywhere in the inheritance hierarchy of a type.

classes.name: IS_STATIC_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a static member function with a specific signature exists in a type.

classes.name: IS_TEMPLATE_MEMBER_AVAILABLE
classes.description: Macro to check if a template member function with a specific signature exists in a type.
